propositions: binding_store.py exceeds sustainable size (800 lines) with mixed concerns: file loading, JSON encoding, tempfile cleanup, rotation ordering, and identity policy entangled together, creating refactoring risk.

Extracting persistence into a private BindingRepository unit-of-work must preserve every existing byte contract, exception behavior, load/save ordering, and JSON serialization format without eager rewrites or format migration.

The repository must maintain rotation-before-live ordering and retired-first move ordering as atomic behavioral contracts, with per-file os.replace and dirty-state gating to prevent silent data loss on partial failures.
Public BindingStore facade must remain unchanged in construction, loader, signatures, and shared inner dictionaries to ensure caller-visible compatibility and avoid deep copies.
Tickets publication through reconcile_helpers.py must continue staging only the existing five allowlisted files with no new checkpoint publishes or broad staging.
The binding-lifecycle ADR must document repository unit-of-work durability semantics separately from external tickets publication and record the exact recovery boundary.
